_comment: Spoken phrase per notification event type. 'default' is the fallback for any type without its own clip. Keys must match the notifications.type / EventType values used by the backend. Each phrase is rendered to <key>_female.mp3 and <key>_male.mp3.
default: You have a new notification from O3 Capital Workspace.
card_cycle_risk: New at-risk card alert. Please review the at-risk cards list.
ticket_unassigned_alert: A support ticket needs your attention.
task_assigned: You have been assigned a new task.
task_due_soon: You have a task due soon.
loan_submitted: A new loan application has been submitted.
loan_stage_changed: There is an update on a loan application.
approval_request: You have a pending approval request.
